label: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
notes: Every change is a new file `supabase/migrations/<timestamp>_<name>.sql` created with `supabase migration new <name>`; an applied migration is never edited.
Row Level Security (RLS) is enabled on every table and its policies ship in the same migration as the table; a table without policies is a review blocker.
`supabase db reset` applies every migration to the local stack; `supabase db push` to a hosted project is a production action that needs owner approval.
A change made in the Supabase dashboard is captured with `supabase db diff -f <name>` before release.
Destructive changes (drop, type narrowing, policy removal) need owner approval and a backup first; the service role key never appears in the repository.
